exitVerificationGuidance: Capture the currently running app PID and its start identity; candidate-process.json records launch PID 23954 but is historical after any restart.

Capture each registered Agent PID together with identity.startedSec, identity.startedUsec, identity.executable, identity.uid and PGID before exit; also retain already-observed descendant identities because a group leader may exit first.

After normal exit, check the same process identities and their owned groups, not arbitrary matching command names or PID presence alone. No process should be signalled during this read-only verification.
A blank pids.json alone is not proof of group exit. A stale record alone is not proof of a live process: unregister follows confirmed Child reap/group exit and can lag on filesystem work.

Expect either the explicit owned-processes-confirmed-stopped log or an unconfirmed shutdown warning; absence of a warning alone does not prove exit. Runtime budgets are TERM at shutdown, KILL after 2 seconds, caller wait at most 5 seconds.
limits: This verifies the saved candidate snapshot against the current source and installed executable identity. It does not independently reproduce the compiler build or cryptographically establish build provenance.
candidate-identity.json does not hash every build input outside src/ and src-tauri/src/; no broader all-input reproducibility claim is made.
A cfg(test)-only change is excluded from a normal application build; test executable coverage is recorded separately in cargo-test.log.
No source edits, whole-suite reruns, repackaging, or process termination were performed for this verification.
